name: Z Mission Breakout
detailed_description:
Z Mission Breakout is a fast-paced top-down twin-stick shooter where you’re humanity’s last hope in a world overrun by the undead and ancient creatures of the night. As chaos reigns, you’re dropped into ground zero with one mission: rescue survivors, eliminate the threat, and break out of the quarantine zone—alive.

Fight through swarms of zombies, vampires, and other nightmarish creatures, using an arsenal of weapons and quick reflexes to survive. Battle your way through a series of tactical missions and action-packed levels where every bullet counts and every wave gets tougher.

Whether you’re here to blast monsters or beat your high score, Z Mission Breakout delivers relentless arcade-style action with survival elements in a gritty, post-apocalyptic setting.

  • Twin-stick shooter gameplay with tight, responsive controls

  • Zombie and mutant enemies with unique behaviors and abilities

  • Intense wave-based combat that scales in difficulty

  • Mission-based progression across multiple breakout zones

  • Power-ups and weapons to upgrade your firepower mid-run

  • Designed for replayability – sharpen your skills and climb the score ranks

  • Retro pixel graphics and dark atmospheric environments

short_description: Fight your way through swarms of mutants and zombies in this intense top-down shooter. Complete rescue missions, survive deadly waves, and break out of the quarantine zone before it's too late. Are you ready to face the outbreak?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-540 or AMD Phenom II X4 965
  • Memory: 2 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTS 250 or Radeon HD 5770
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not Supported
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 650 or AMD Radeon R7 250X
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not Supported

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.12 (Sierra)
  • Processor: 2 GHz dual-core processor (Apple M1 or Intel Core M)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA or AMD graphics with at least 512 MB VRAM, OpenGL 2.0+
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard macOS-compatible audio
  • Additional Notes: Fully supports Intel and Apple Silicon (M1) via Rosetta

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 or equivalent
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 2.1-compatible GPU
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: ALSA-compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported
